##### Project general facts

Vivo South is a contemporary residential development that brings modern urban living to life with a refined and elegant concept. It offers a selection of thoughtfully designed studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, catering to a wide range of lifestyle needs and preferences. With its Urban Chic architectural style and a strong focus on functionality, the project creates a perfect balance between comfort, design, and everyday practicality.

The development stands out with a rich and carefully curated selection of lifestyle amenities designed to enhance daily living. Residents can enjoy facilities such as a swimming pool, gym, outdoor gym, jogging track, and landscaped seating areas, all contributing to an active and relaxing environment. Additional features like a co-working space, outdoor cinema, kids play area, BBQ area, koi pond, and working pods create a vibrant and community-oriented atmosphere where leisure and productivity coexist seamlessly.

The interiors are designed with a strong emphasis on style, quality, and comfort, featuring modern finishes and a sophisticated material palette. Each apartment is crafted with stylish interiors that reflect a clean, contemporary aesthetic while maintaining a warm and welcoming feel. The use of quality finishes and well-thought-out layouts ensures a refined living experience, where every detail — from kitchen spaces to overall furnishing concepts — supports both elegance and everyday convenience.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Industrial City is among the UAE’s largest industrial zones, positioned near Al Maktoum International Airport and Jebel Ali Port, which makes it a key element of Dubai’s industrial and logistics network. While its primary role is industrial, the area also provides modern housing and essential amenities for employees and their families.

Residents of Dubai Industrial City benefit from a wide range of nearby facilities, including shopping centers, retail outlets, restaurants, and healthcare services, all designed to ensure everyday convenience. Its location offers quick access to major highways such as Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, linking the community efficiently with central areas like Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina.

This district is well-suited for professionals in industrial sectors who wish to stay close to their workplace while maintaining a comfortable lifestyle. With affordable housing, a calm environment, and strong transport connectivity, Dubai Industrial City appeals to both individuals and families. Its focus on sustainability and eco-friendly practices further enhances its reputation as a progressive community in Dubai.
